notes.title: New BGM added
notes.notes:
New BGM added
The background of the first level has more things
The annoying water sound removed

notes.title: Fixed bugs and reduced difficulty overall
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug of the respawn point in the second level stuck on the wall.
Spider Caro's movement speed has been increased.
Spider silk speed has been increased.
Spider silk distance has been increased.
The difficulty of the first level has been reduced.

notes.title: Submit suggestions or bug reports to Spider Caro.
notes.notes: Because the game is new, I haven't considered other players' skills, so the difficulty is relatively high. And there are still some bugs in the game. If you have any opinions or encounter bugs, please raise them here. I will try my best to fix them in the next update and reduce the difficulty of the game overall.
